measurementRules.acceptanceLatency: monotonic elapsed time around one pure command application; report microseconds
measurementRules.projectionBytes: UTF-8 bytes of canonical JSON state projection after the workload
measurementRules.cpu: process user+system microseconds over the complete workload; report microseconds
measurementRules.memory: resident-set bytes before/after and peak when the host exposes it; report bytes
measurementRules.journalGrowth: UTF-8 bytes added to the canonical append-only transition history; native SQLite growth is a separate observation
measurementRules.replayTime: monotonic elapsed time to replay the complete bounded history; report microseconds
measurementRules.aggregation: median, p95, minimum, maximum, sample count; do not average censored or failed runs

comparison.promotion: compare same workload and method; retain failed/censored runs; no safety regression; synthetic values are not provider evidence
